entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine provides sub-300ms recall for Hermes Agents using a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount. It features automated fact extraction and connects to external platforms including Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain generates cited prose answers with explicit gap analysis and extracts typed entity edges for knowledge graphs without LLM calls. It supports multi-user institutional memory while maintaining login-scoped data privacy.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes information via a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to achieve a 91% token reduction and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system enables agents to learn through structured retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the upstream foundation for building stateful agents with hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It includes a FastAPI server and supports both Python and TypeScript client SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control operations like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates with sub-millisecond speed using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness generates playbooks, hints, and datasets from agent runs to improve performance on complex tasks. It offers MCP server capabilities and supports integration via Python and TypeScript/Node CLI surfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store and a hierarchical DAG to ensure no messages are lost. It builds depth-aware summary nodes and provides tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for cross-session persistence, allowing Hermes Agents to maintain private memory via Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compliant provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets management across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It automates memory creation from transcripts and files, achieving a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format. It enables local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor users.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, to provide memory via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3x and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. Its five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and supports contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for major coding agents with automated configuration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between stored notes and supports automated indexing for codebases and multimedia.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the necessary context. This local-first layer renders context to assistant-specific files, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing cross-project memory as inspectable Markdown files. It operates without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing DuckDB solely as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to store memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to enable self-paying API capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It features HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall, including MinHash dedup and metadata filters.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports automatic tool-OKF generation through an opt-in process.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and supports grounded Q&A with specific file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic software development methodology centered on subagent-driven engineering. It incorporates TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles and supports harnesses such as Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that generates HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 artifacts. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes, and features a sandboxed iframe preview for HTML artifacts.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for natural language diagram generation.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This library provides spec-conformant Agent Plugins and 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution. It integrates fragmented ecosystem layers into a single skill compatible with Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection includes 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for various AI tools including ChatGPT and Gemini.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation alongside management slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides access to YouTube transcripts, searches, channels, and playlists via TranscriptAPI. It is compatible with the Agent Skills format and works with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and OpenClaw.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside an evaluation of potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that include instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports skill management via remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough concepts to structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow features Lite and Full complexity modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into synchronized documents. It allows agents to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically sync code edits back to the primary file.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file-backed or SQLite cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and facilitates cross-feature learning during execution.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It provides specialized skills for CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and CRE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community with installation guides and skills formatted for the agentskills.io standard in Portuguese. it provides localized resources to support the configuration and deployment of Hermes Agent.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integrations and prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. The suite also includes six specialized skills for FLUX 3 video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant skills. It automatically extracts function signatures and types while maintaining a full audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client, a CLI, and commerce capabilities utilizing TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures reliability for long-running operations with built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language for AI that uses a single file and four verbs to define 'Intent as Code.' It supports local-first execution with any model and provides static auditing alongside hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram by tailoring rewrites to specific model families and reasoning capabilities. It preserves non-English prompts through specialized heuristics and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews using three parallel subagents that analyze edge cases and integration risks without modifying the code. It combines a deterministic pre-scan layer using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with an MCP server to manage suppression rules.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It features mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a three-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system to categorize modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns like N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This project provides a turnkey cybersecurity environment featuring over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to support CVE-driven tasks.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is built to the agentskills.io standard, ensuring native compatibility with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw environments.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It generates cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures, allowing developers to prove a skill's reliability via a public API.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates for Hermes Agent. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests, producing structured reports that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Adhering to the agentskills.io open standard, this collection provides specialized utilities for video-to-text conversion and document OCR for PDFs. It also features an E-commerce Material Studio and tools for refining AI-generated text, expanding the agent's multimedia processing capabilities.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and guides for hardware and UI access using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers a Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices using proot-distro. It supports local models via Ollama and is compatible with multiple AI model providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and costs via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane allows for the operation of multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and offers enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This production package is distributed via GitHub Releases and can run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit, allowing for side-by-side execution with an installed Hermes instance.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and supports data submission for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic from Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, and other coding agents. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs. It synchronizes usage data across multiple devices and tracks session details from local databases.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It coordinates seven specialized agents and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community CLI tool allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with custom banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configuration to support various aesthetics, such as cyberpunk or retro DOS.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform serves as a social economy for autonomous AI agents, featuring encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and supports identity registration with human-readable @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama. It includes a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph and CrewAI. It includes memory apps for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, as well as a plugin for Claude Code with automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, skills, and local memories. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents through project-local instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to enable rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It identifies missing stop conditions, unbounded retries, and ambiguous or overlapping tool descriptions using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, local functionality with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface for managing multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that provides a unified interface for various agent CLIs. It supports remote access through WebUI, Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat, and includes 21 built-in professional assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JS-based web interface designed for accessing Hermes Agent via browser or SSH tunnel. It features workspace file browsing with inline preview capabilities.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It offers a GUI for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It supports 10 platform channels, including Telegram and Discord, and includes visual workflow building and Kanban task tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers and includes a full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports delegation to sub-agents and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows and macOS desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime for local kernel management and features UI for chat, MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and Hermes Web Alpha for session and runtime management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent. It allows users to manage sessions, tasks, and skills while providing read-only access to memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard serves as a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal and real-time chat with tool call visualization to monitor agent health and system metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that provides a searchable history for various coding-agent CLIs while tracking live quota burn per session. It operates entirely locally without telemetry, functioning as a private analytics and limits tracker for Hermes users.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It distinguishes itself by integrating a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project offers a terminal-based alternative for chatting with agents and managing their sessions. It includes a dedicated kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This Next.js and React-based dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It is specifically designed with an approval inbox to manage and authorize agent requests that have side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes functionality to the Telegram Mini App platform with HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment capabilities.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, making it a highly portable solution for local or cloud AI workflows. It features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers and supports local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It centralizes the management of skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a task-tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard tracks session activity and costs in real time while allowing users to inspect conversation histories. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration settings for secure process oversight.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for interactive agent control. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, supported by isolated profile management for distinct memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a project manager interface. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports rapid model switching during streaming chat sessions.
